predictions.selection_reason: User-controlled dataType parameter -> regex-based parsing with core_rnotwhite -> controls how AJAX responses are processed and validated
predictions.source_summary: s.dataType comes from user-provided options object passed to jQuery.ajax() function, with default value "*" if not specified
predictions.sink_summary: Parsed dataTypes[0] is used to set HTTP Accept header via jqXHR.setRequestHeader(), controlling how server responses are processed
predictions.guard_summary: No explicit validation of dataType values against allowlist; core_rnotwhite regex (/\S+/g) only splits on whitespace but doesn't restrict content
predictions.risk_pattern: User-controlled dataType parameter is parsed and directly used to construct HTTP Accept header without validation, potentially allowing header injection or unexpected MIME type processing
predictions.context_summary: In jQuery.ajax() function, dataType parameter is parsed into dataTypes array which determines Accept header and response processing behavior
unresolved_facts: Whether s.accepts object has any validation or sanitization for unknown dataType values
How unknown dataType values are handled in the Accept header construction
Whether there are any downstream validation mechanisms for the constructed Accept header

retrieval_query.mechanism_summary: User-controlled dataType parameter parsed without validation and used to construct HTTP Accept header
retrieval_query.missing_control: input validation of MIME type/dataType values
retrieval_query.impact: header injection, content type confusion, response processing manipulation
